test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 09 Feb 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: There is no requirement to maintain any minimum balance _______ in accounts.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana(PMJDY)** is a financial inclusion scheme launched on **28 August 2014** by **PM Narendra Modi.**
 
• He announced this scheme in his first Independence Day speech on 15 August 2014.
 
• The **slogan **for this scheme is **"Mera Khata Bhagya Vidhata."**
 
• The nodal ministry of this scheme is the **Ministry of Finance(MoF).**
 
• The main objective of this scheme is to provide universal access to banking facilities to all households in the country.
 
• The scheme provides basic banking facilities like a savings account, deposit accounts, and remittance services.
 
• **Benefits under PMJDY**:
 
 
• **One basic savings bank account is opened for unbanked people**.
 
• There is** no requirement to maintain any minimum balance** in PMJDY accounts.
 
• **Rupay Debit card is provided** to PMJDY account holders.
 
• **Accident Insurance Cover of Rs.1 lakh** (enhanced to Rs. 2 lakh for new PMJDY accounts opened after 28.8.2018) is available with a RuPay card issued to the PMJDY account holders.
 
• An **overdraft (OD) facility up to Rs. 10,000** to eligible account holders is available.
 
• PMJDY accounts are eligible for Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT), Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY), Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY), Atal Pension Yojana (APY), Micro Units Development & Refinance Agency Bank (MUDRA) scheme.
